name: Zenithal-Gnomon
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, asteroid belt proximity. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Vacuous air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
exotic matter deposit bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
There is money in aluminum, titanium, silicon and iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
